payload.body: You tend to try the unusual format, join the unexpected group, or build a routine that makes sense to you without needing the choice to shock anyone. Difference is part of daily life, not an event that requires an audience. You usually trust that individuality can coexist with ordinary commitments. Other people often become more willing to experiment around you because you make change look usable.
